title: Add memory and resource leak prevention gate

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official source lookup for Python, Node.js, Playwright, and Next.js resource/memory guidance.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.bottleneck_notes: Governance mode selected because evaluator, policy, workflow, and memory anchors changed.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Paired Korean/English requirements, spec, and traceability artifacts add overhead but preserve future context.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Largest phase: adding resource guard, evaluator fields, CLI, docs, policies, workflow, prompt, and memory links.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Unit tests and resource/work-mode/evaluator gates passed.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Omission, resource, grounding, and work evaluation records were created and checked.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Final git staging, commit, push, and status confirmation.

bottleneck_analysis.notes: The main cost is governance fan-out across code, config, bilingual docs, memory anchors, history, and evaluation records.
